title: Fishing
simplified_paragraphs: 有个老人在钓鱼，一个小孩走过去看他。老人觉得小孩很可爱，要把所有的鱼都送给他，但是小孩摇摇头，老人感到很奇怪，问：“为什么不要呢？”
小孩回答：“爷爷，我很喜欢吃鱼，但是这些鱼很快就会吃完。如果你教我学会了钓鱼，我就可以自己钓，这样一辈子也吃不完。”
traditional_paragraphs: 有個老人在釣魚，一個小孩走過去看他。老人覺得小孩很可愛，要把所有的魚都送給他，但是小孩搖搖頭，老人感到很奇怪，問：“為什麼不要呢？”
小孩回答：“爺爺，我很喜歡吃魚，但是這些魚很快就會吃完。如果你教我學會了釣魚，我就可以自己釣，這樣一輩子也吃不完。”
pinyin_paragraphs: yǒu gè lǎo rén zài diào yú， yī gè xiǎo hái zǒu guò qù kàn tā。 lǎo rén jué de xiǎo hái hěn kě ài， yào bǎ suǒ yǒu de yú dōu sòng gěi tā， dàn shì xiǎo hái yáo yáo tóu， lǎo rén gǎn dào hěn qí guài， wèn：“ wèi shén me bù yào ne？”
xiǎo hái huí dá：“ yé ye， wǒ hěn xǐ huan chī yú， dàn shì zhè xiē yú hěn kuài jiù huì chī wán。 rú guǒ nǐ jiāo wǒ xué huì le diào yú， wǒ jiù kě yǐ zì jǐ diào， zhè yàng yī bèi zi yě chī bù wán。”
english_paragraphs: An old man was fishing when a child came over to watch him. The old man thought the child was adorable and offered to give him all the fish he had caught. But the child shook his head. Puzzled, the old man asked, “Why don’t you want them?”
The child replied, “Grandpa, I love eating fish, but these fish will soon be gone. If you teach me how to fish, I can catch my own, and I’ll have fish to eat for the rest of my life.”
english_full:
An old man was fishing when a child came over to watch him. The old man thought the child was adorable and offered to give him all the fish he had caught. But the child shook his head. Puzzled, the old man asked, “Why don’t you want them?”

The child replied, “Grandpa, I love eating fish, but these fish will soon be gone. If you teach me how to fish, I can catch my own, and I’ll have fish to eat for the rest of my life.”
